title: Do a few early tokens decide the algorithm? (screen of alternate 3, fork tokens decide the idea)
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B (bf16, thinking OFF via enable_thinking=False), vLLM 0.11.0
fallback_model_rule: Qwen/Qwen3-4B for ALL arms only if Qwen3-8B fails to initialise after memory retries; decided before any arm runs

decoding.seed: stable sha256 hash of (task, condition, paraphrase, arm/base path, prefix_len, rep) mod 2^31; vLLM children seed+index

tasks: T1 unweighted grid path (catalogue BFS, DFS, bidirectional_BFS, IDDFS, astar_greedy, unit_dijkstra)
T2 weighted shortest path (catalogue dijkstra, bellman_ford_spfa, bidirectional_dijkstra, floyd_warshall, dial)

conditions.ban: ban:BFS on T1, ban:Dijkstra on T2 (10 paraphrases)

screen_S7.base_paths: sample 0 of each paraphrase (G1 baseline, G2 ban): 10 per task x condition
screen_S7.o_0: labels of the other samples of the same paraphrase (19 baseline, 9 ban)

cpd_S8.statistic: G = 2 * N_seg * JS_w (nats), size-weighted JS = multinomial LR
cpd_S8.null: 1000 permutations of continuation labels across the segment's positions; threshold = 95th percentile of permuted max G
cpd_S8.o0_handling: o_0 is included as grid position 0 so forks in tokens 1-4 are detectable (declared deviation: plan text said o_0 reported but not segmented); a CPD run without o_0 is also reported
cpd_S8.sensitivity: ruptures PELT with custom multinomial cost, penalty by 5-fold CV over continuations

localise_confirm_S9.localise: 8 continuations at the 3 intermediate positions of each bracket; fork t = argmax_s TVD(o_s, o_{s+1})
localise_confirm_S9.control_pairs: one per path with any candidate, q ~ U[4,88], >= 8 tokens from every candidate, 30 at q and q+1
localise_confirm_S9.confirmed_fork: permutation chi-square p < 0.05 AND TVD >= 0.20 AND sharpness = TVD(o_t,o_t+1)/TVD(o_{p_prev},o_p) >= 0.5

swap_S10.cut: c* = first confirmed fork t else commit_idx (baseline base paths)
readouts: lock-in rate = banned share under ban at post
swap_S10.prediction: ban effect at pre > ban effect at post

knob_S11.hot_set: up to 3 most frequent first-confirmed-fork indices among the task's baseline paths; fallback chain: baseline forks -> ban forks of the same task -> mode of commit_idx over G1; H = union {f-2..f+2}

arms.RANDOM_WINDOW: same number of 5-token windows, centres ~ U[2,94] >= 5 tokens from any fork index, T=1.3 there, 0.3 elsewhere
arms.ANCHORED: T=0.3 until the opening ```python fence, then 1.3 for 5 tokens, then 0.3

predicted_signs: FORK within-mode phrasing Hill < global T=1.3

probes_S12.model: StandardScaler + PCA(64) in-fold, multinomial LogisticRegression C in {0.01,0.1,1} by inner 3-fold CV, outer StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle, seed 0)
probes_S12.reference: prompt-only predictor = in-fold label frequencies per (condition, paraphrase), add-0.5 smoothing
probes_S12.nulls: 20 global label shuffles + 20 within-(condition, paraphrase) permutations per cell on every second layer (fixed C)
probes_S12.significant: IG above all 20 within-prompt null values
probes_S12.ci: clustered bootstrap over 20 prompt clusters, 1000 resamples

analysis_S13.R0: share of base paths with a_0 >= 0.8 (a_k = share of continuations agreeing with the path's own final label)
analysis_S13.fixed_by: a >= 7/8 at every grid position >= k, k in {0,8,16,32,64}
analysis_S13.F1: share of non-fixed paths with >= 1 confirmed fork
analysis_S13.F2: median share of TVD(o_0, onehot(final)) realised at confirmed forks
analysis_S13.D1: IG at k_pre or k_fork significant vs within-prompt null
analysis_S13.K1: Hill_cc(FORK) - Hill_cc(RANDOM_WINDOW) with paraphrase-cluster bootstrap 95% CI
analysis_S13.K2: FORK vs global-T (pass rate, Hill_cc) frontier by linear interpolation
analysis_S13.K3: FORK phrasing Hill vs global 1.3 and 0.3

verdict_rules.SUPPORTED: ban condition pooled over tasks: F1 >= 0.5 with F3 <= 0.15, F2 >= 0.5, D1 significant at k_pre or k_fork, AND K1 CI excludes 0 in favour of FORK on >= 1 task
verdict_rules.REFUTED: R0 >= 0.8 in all four task x conditions, OR (F1 < 0.25 AND K1 CI includes 0 or favours RANDOM_WINDOW on both tasks)
verdict_rules.PARTIAL-LOCUS: the fork criteria pass but K1 fails

labeller.final_label: runtime label when resolved, else AST label
labeller.judge: OpenRouter cheap models, temperature 0, only on tracer/AST disagreements and 'other' labels in gold set, confirmation/swap continuations, knob arms and decoder samples; hard stop at 1.00 USD
labeller.gate: 100% on references (tracer and AST), Cohen kappa(tracer, AST) >= 0.8 on gold set, tracer-vs-adjudicated agreement >= 90%

reduction_ladder: control pairs on every second path
screen base paths 10 -> 8 -> 6 per task x condition (drop highest paraphrase ids)
declared_deviations: closing-fence stop string (cuts post-code prose only)
HF cache = run's shared cache (system rule) instead of ./hf_cache
harness fails fast after the first timeout or 3 failed cases (passed is unaffected)
o_0 included as grid position 0 in CPD
